title: Transfer pointwise gadget lift bounds to global tour TV without inverse rare-event conditioning
statement: If each good gadget supplies e^(plus/minus eta_i) pointwise lift-density control for EVERY original tour, the product lifts differ by e^(plus/minus h),h=sum eta_i. Normalizing contributes one more e^(plus/minus h), hence the projected tour density lies within e^(plus/minus2h) of uniform and TV<=exp(2h)-1. Add the unconditioned bad-construction probability and walk error explicitly, with a valid fallback output. This uses a pointwise bound at every original tour, not merely a local TV guarantee followed by free conditioning on a rare global one-cycle event. The source interface avoids any inverse one-cycle probability; it does not construct the missing fast sampling backend.
